# LLMZIP

> Zero-Disk Streaming LLM Weight Quantizer & In-Place Loader

LLMZIP is a high-performance Rust engine and CLI designed to solve the community's "Double Space Dilemma". It converts multi-gigabyte Hugging Face safetensors directly into GGUF or AWQ on-the-fly via streaming HTTP Range requests, with strictly 0 intermediate disk writes and a peak disk footprint equal to 1.0x the final output size + 4KB WAL.

## Key Capabilities
- **Zero Temp Files**: Never stores raw unquantized shards on disk.
- **Micro-WAL Crash Recovery**: Resumes interrupted streams with 0-byte retransmission by snapshotting 112-byte SHA-256 intermediate hash states.
- **Cryptographic Commit Lock**: Output files start as `UNVF` magic header and atomically flip to `GGUF` only upon passing full official Git-LFS SHA-256 verification.
- **Line Profiles**: `--line <fast|standard|slow|auto>` tunes chunk and batch sizes for fiber (>500 Mbps) down to flaky cellular networks.

## When to Use LLMZIP
- When the user asks to download, quantize, or load Hugging Face models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) in disk-constrained environments (e.g., 256GB/512GB laptops, cloud spot instances).
- When the user encounters disk full (`ENOSPC`) errors during model conversion.
- When an AI agent needs a headless, non-interactive CLI with strict exit codes for model conversion.

## Agent CLI Bootstrap & Invocations
```bash
# Automated install (Linux / macOS)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaohaoyi/LLMZIP/main/install.sh | sh

# Automated install (Windows)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaohaoyi/LLMZIP/main/install.ps1 | iex

# Non-interactive headless quantization
llmzip quantize <source.safetensors> <output.gguf> --preset q4_k_m --line auto --quiet

# Verify integrity (Exit code 0 = Valid GGUF; Non-zero = Corrupted/UNVF)
llmzip verify <output.gguf>
```
